subject: Feedback on assessment turnaround times
body:
Hi team,

I wanted to pass on some feedback rather than make a formal fuss. My last two assessments in the Diploma of Community Services took over five weeks to come back, which made it hard to know if I was on track before the next unit started. The trainers are lovely — it just seems like the marking pipeline is stretched. Something to look at?

Best,
Annette
